name: Lamotrigine
aliases: Qin, Qín, Gizord, Lamictal, Lamictal®, Lamotrigina, Lamotriginum
summary: Lamotrigine ( luh-MOH-trih-jeen), sold under the brand name Lamictal among others, is a medication used to treat epilepsy and stabilize mood in bipolar disorder. For epilepsy, this includes focal seizures, tonic-clonic seizures, and seizures in Lennox-Gastaut syndrome.
